findings.action: Exclude CommonMark comment nodes from the HTML attribute fallback and add inline/block comment regressions in both association directions while retaining unknown for actual raw HTML links.
findings.rationale: The HTML fallback also examines CommonMark comments. For example, becomes a goldmark HTMLBlockType2, whose complete text reaches htmlLink at line 96; href= therefore produces an unknown association. Inline comments take the analogous RawHTML path. A comment in any inventoried ADR can consequently block an otherwise valid when-justified exemption. This is conservative over-enforcement, not an exemption bypass. Source evidence: the AST dispatch at lines 80-96, the attribute expression at line 109, and goldmark parser/html_block.go's comment classification.
